*Standard Ironmen will have restrictions imposed on them: they cannot trade, take items belonging to other players, nor accept their help. In other words, they are entirely self-sufficient and do everything for themselves.
*Hardcore Ironmen not only face the standard restrictions, but also have only one life. In the event of a death that is not safe, the Hardcore status will be downgraded to a standard and the stats will be frozen on the Hardcore Ironman hiscores.
*Ultimate Ironmen, in addition to the standard restrictions, cannot use the bank. When they die, all carried items will be dropped directly to the ground and will remain there for an hour after death, after which the items will despawn.
